easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with three or more charge counters on it
